name: Ami Arakawa
source: Sensei's niece, who has lived with him for years after the untimely death of her parents in a car accident. She has a devoted and loving nature, and takes care of most domestic tasks from cooking to waking Sensei up in the morning. She can be found in her bedroom on weekend mornings.
